correctness.rationale: For each frequency K, expansion over its prescribed singleton blocks proves lambda(n,k)=sum_j binom(k,j)(-2)^j Bell(n-j). Dobiński gives the exact Poisson mixed moment. Even k are positive; odd k<n are positive except (n,k)=(2,1), by explicit r=3,4 positive-tail bounds; odd k=n are negative only at 1,3,5,7 and positive from 9 onward by an exact two-term r=5,6 bound. Fourier multiplicity binom(n,k) gives complete inertia. The extracted standard-library verifier passed 12,652 exact assertions with independent restricted-growth string enumeration and Walsh sums through n=11 and finite sign checks through n=90. Finite verification is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
